## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (or an explanation of why not)
- [ ] **Thresholds/peaks unchanged** — no files in `tests/baselines/` changed
- [ ] OR baselines intentionally changed: ran `pytest --update-baselines`, reviewed the diff, filled in `tests/baselines/CHANGELOG.md`, and a domain expert approved the change
- [ ] Known bugs found are covered by a strict `xfail` test
